name: Penn Sheet Metal
old_description: Locally and family-owned, we’ve served the needs of our loyal customers since 1921. We guarantee your satisfaction with our products and services!
about:
Penn Sheet Metal operates from Allentown, Pennsylvania, where it has been locally and family-owned since 1921. The company began as a sheet metal fabrication shop serving the construction trade, though the names of its original founders are not publicly documented.

The shop specializes in architectural metals, manufacturing, and precision cutting services. Its processes include laser cutting, waterjet cutting, CNC turret punching, and CNC routing, supporting both large and small production runs. The facility produces roof panel systems (snap lock and mechanical seam), drainage products such as square and extruded downspouts and box gutters, soffits and wall panels, and metal wall panel systems. It also fabricates custom items including angle stands, bins, conveyor pans, gates, hoppers, platforms, tanks, weldments, tubing frames, and dust collection units.

Customers span the construction industry, particularly contractors and builders specifying gutter, roof, and wall panel systems. The company's architectural metal products are used in commercial and residential building projects, with concrete examples including roof panels carrying a 35-year finish warranty, drainage components, and quick-turn soffit and wall panel assemblies.

Penn Sheet Metal emphasizes its 100-plus years of experience, family ownership, and available warranties as differentiators. It offers in-store pickup and delivery, free quotes, and quick turnaround on soffit and wall panel orders to keep projects on schedule.
